name: BioFi Deep Dive: building farmer-owned regenerative supply systems
description: The last BioFi Deep Dive of 2026, with Luke Smith, co-founder of Origins Co-op. Origins is building farmer-owned market infrastructure with around 500 smallholder farmers in southern Thailand who are turning rubber plantations into diverse agroforests. A rich look at how whole watersheds could move to regenerative farming together. Monday 14 December 2026, 11:30am to 1pm Eastern (8:30 to 10am Pacific); Online, on Zoom; Register on their event page. Offered by The BioFi Project. Listed in the Relational River's Springs; join through the makers' own page.
